topic.label: Italian
topic.desc: Italian: the Italian language, its dialects and history, and the literature, cinema and culture of Italy from Dante to the present.

concepts: Morphology and syntax of standard Italian: articles, agreement, verb conjugation, moods, tenses, clitic pronouns and word order.
Sounds of Italian: vowels, double consonants, stress, intonation and regional pronunciation.
History of the Language and Dialects
From Latin to the questione della lingua and Tuscan standard, and the regional dialects and languages of Italy.
Italian literature from Dante, Petrarch and Boccaccio through the Renaissance, Romanticism and modern writers.
Translation between Italian and other languages, register, idiom and specialised vocabulary.
Italian cinema, art, music, regional culture and contemporary society and politics.
